status: Human RGB annotations evaluated; no independent high-speed reference; not publication breakthrough
nominal_sampling: native 30fps labels, retain frameID mod 3 for nominal 10fps; no shutter or timestamp validation
failure_gates: Clip 1 .tag blob 1,057,408 bytes yielded empty content through fetch_file; excluded before outcome inspection; no imputation.
EyeBlink8 tags are RGB-based manual annotations, not an independently synchronized 100Hz+ ocular reference.
Source acquisition timestamp files absent in mirrored subset; frame-index decimation is not physical 10fps acquisition.
Device/participant identity mapping not independently verified; clip 11 is a glasses-flagged holdout, not a device/participant holdout.
conclusion: Every-third-frame decimation preserved all annotated blink intervals, but removed all native full-closure evidence in 74 of 1053 phase-by-event cases (7.03%). The sharp mechanism is 1/2-frame closure runs vs three decimation phases; do not equate blink detection with closure completeness.
